subject: Charlock Castle
text: A treasure chest in Charlock Castle contains the Sword of Erdrick.

evidence.quote: you'll find the treasure chest that contains the SWORD OF ERDRICK.

subject: Charlock Castle
text: From the cave start, take the first path down-left to a staircase, follow the clockwise passage to the next down staircase, go right and up, then left past a down staircase to a second down staircase, go right along the bottom and up, climb two up staircases, and descend the lower-left staircase to the chest with the Sword of Erdrick.

evidence.quote: From the start of the cave, just follow the first path as it winds down and...to the left, to a waiting staircase you can descend....staircase, you'll just need to follow the next passage in a clockwise...direction, around to the next descending staircase....In the new passage, head right along the path, and follow it upward....but you should ignore it and move left to where...a second descending staircase waits....From the lower left one where you arrived, head...right along the bottom, then up so that you're at the just right of the room's...other ascending staircase....Once you've climbed that staircase, you'll see another ascending staircase to...Climb those stairs, then the ones in the next room....In the room beyond, descend the staircase you'll see to your lower left, and there...you'll find the treasure chest that contains the SWORD OF ERDRICK.

subject: Charlock Castle
text: If everyone is at level 10 or better, you can run from most enemies in Charlock Castle.

evidence.quote: Fortunately, if everyone is at level 10 or...better, you can run from most of the enemies.

subject: Charlock Castle final area
text: The final area of Charlock Castle has numerous treasure chests behind a door that needs the Golden Key.

evidence.quote: There are numerous treasure chests here beyond a door that you'll need the golden key to unlock.

subject: Charlock Castle final area
text: The floor of the Charlock Castle final area is a trap that drains HP with each step.

evidence.quote: Not only that, but the floor is a huge trap that will severely drain your life with each step.

subject: Charlock Castle final area
text: The guide advises returning to the Charlock Castle final area much later in the game.

evidence.quote: Best to come back here much later.

subject: Charlock Castle
text: From the room, cross to the staircase after going down the hall, left, and up to the next descending staircase, which leads to the final area where the Dragonlord's grandson is.

evidence.quote: The next passage is simple....Just wind your way down the hall, then left,...then up to the next descending staircase....Finally, you can cross this room to enter the staircase that leads to the...dungeon's final area, where you'll find the Dragonlord's grandson.

subject: Lianport
text: To reach World Tree Island from Lianport, sail north to the shoals, sail north to a small partly forested island, then sail due east until you see a desert island surrounded by mountains.

evidence.quote: From Tantagel, head back west to Lianport, and sail north to the...shoals where you found the 'Tresure.'  From there, sail north until a small,...partially forested island comes into view.  Next, sail due east for quite a...bit, until you see a desert island mostly surrounded by mountainous peaks.
